items.title: Plan Bea
items.overview: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.

items.title: Nichts wie weg
items.overview: Nurse Anke Bender reacts decisively to inappropriate behavior. After a patient gropes her, she slaps him. Unfortunately, the patient turns out to be none other than Hamburg’s health senator, who dies the very next day following an incorrectly administered IV. To avoid arrest, Anke impulsively flees in an ambulance—unaware that the injured pianist Luise Dobertin is inside.

items.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
items.overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

items.title: Tad Stones und die Wunderlampe
items.overview: Tad und Sara sehen sich mit dem wohl bisher größten Abenteuer ihres gemeinsamen Lebens konfrontiert: Sie sind Eltern geworden. Ihr Tochter haben sie Olimpia getauft. Doch der Familienzuwachs sorgt nicht unbedingt überall für euphorischen Jubel. Momia zum Beispiel muss nun damit klarkommen, dass ausnahmsweise mal jemand anderes im Zentrum der Aufmerksamkeit steht. Doch das Leben geht natürlich weiter – und zwar im Urlaub. In London stöbert Sara doch tatsächlich die Wunderlampe aus „Tausendundeiner Nacht“ auf. Und Momia will damit am liebsten zurück in die Vergangenheit und zur eigenen Jugend reisen. Aber Zeitreisen lassen selten jeden Stein auf dem anderen...

items.title: Yellow Mirror
items.overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre in this Disney+ exclusive.

items.title: Barreda
items.overview: In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

items.title: Das Ende der Sterne wie Big Hig sie kannte
items.overview: Nachdem die Weltbevölkerung von einer Pandemie heimgesucht wurde, lebt ein Mann ein einsames Dasein in einem Flugzeughangar in Colorado, zusammen mit seinem Hund und einem mürrischen Schützen, mit dem er sich angefreundet hat. Als er mit seiner alten Cessna fliegt, empfängt er eine mysteriöse Funkübertragung, die ihn dazu veranlasst, nach der Herkunft des Signals zu suchen.

items.title: Once More
items.overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

items.title: Biff the Human Slayer
items.overview: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

items.title: Desert Fiends 2
items.overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

items.title: Traffic Jam Comedy Jam Vol 4
items.overview: Traffic Jam Comedy Jam is a stand up comedy series produced by Marc Brissett. Brisset was inspired by Def Jam comedy from the 90's. Marc Brissett's hope is that the series helps to launch careers of several stand up comedians. The series was shot at Room52 in Mid town Manhattan, NY.

items.title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
items.overview: Tate (Craig Fairbrass) battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

items.title: Good Boy Gone Best
items.overview: To shape their son's upbringing, a couple orchestrates a reality where wealth and poverty. As the boy comes of age and uncovers the truth, the facade cracks, exposing a shocking reality.

items.title: ASI Babita Singh Reporting
items.overview: An under-estimated cop visiting her in-laws for the first time finds herself torn between uncovering the truth in a murder investigation and the hidden lies in her own marriage.

items.title: Buddy
items.overview: Remember BUDDY—the bright orange unicorn and star of that classic childrens' television show who brought joy and life lessons into your living room?  Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

items.title: The Cycle of Love
items.overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.
